description: Submit up to 500 URLs (Pro: 5000) in a single atomic request. Each job gets its own token. Quota is deducted atomically; partial batches never happen. Returns a list of {url, token, status, job_id} for each job. Jobs are private by default (retrieve via the download URL from get_status); pass cdn=true (batch-level or per job) for permanent public CDN URLs. Add a callback_url to receive each result as it completes instead of polling.

autoplay_videos.description: Default autoplay_videos for all jobs. Launches Chromium with --autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required so unmuted <video autoplay> elements start playing. Pro only.

block_ads.description: Block ads/trackers for all jobs. Pro only.

callback_secret.description: Shared secret echoed in each callback payload.

callback_url.description: HTTPS URL to POST each result to as they complete.

cdn.description: Publish all jobs to the public CDN. Default: private (per-job cdn overrides this).

crop_height.description: Default custom height in px for all jobs. Pro only.

dismiss_cookies.description: Default cookie-banner handling for all jobs. Pro only.

emulate_print_media.description: Default emulate_print_media for all jobs. Applies the page's print stylesheet. Pro only.

frame.description: Default frame for all jobs (rounded, shadow, browser_chrome, browser_chrome_dark, mobile, mobile_light, tablet, tablet_light, laptop, polaroid, gradient, shotbot_brand).

hidpi.description: Render at 2× DPR for all jobs.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key (16-128 chars alphanumeric / - _ .). If the same key is replayed within 24h, the server returns the original response without creating new jobs or deducting quota — safe for retries. Auto-generated by this MCP tool if omitted.

jobs.description: Array of capture jobs. Each item must have a `url`. Other options override global defaults.

cdn.description: Publish this job to the public CDN. Default: private (overrides the batch-level cdn).

omit_background.description: Default omit_background for all jobs. Transparent viewport backdrop on PNG/WebP/AVIF. Pro only.

output_size.description: Default output size for all jobs.

prefers_reduced_motion.description: Default prefers_reduced_motion for all jobs. Emulates prefers-reduced-motion: reduce so well-built sites skip animations.

preset.description: Default preset for all jobs (og, mobile, square, etc).

ratio.description: Default crop ratio for all jobs (e.g. "16:9").

render_region.description: Default render region for all jobs. fr-paris free, others Pro.

scroll_before_capture.description: Scroll to trigger lazy-load for all jobs. Pro only.

scroll_offset_px.description: Default scroll-down offset (0-30000 px) before capture. Mutually exclusive with scroll_to. Pro only.

scroll_to.description: Default CSS selector (typically an element id, e.g. "#pricing") to scroll into view before capture. Resolved via querySelector. Mutually exclusive with scroll_offset_px. Pro only.

selector.description: Default CSS selector clip for all jobs. Pro only.

viewport_width.description: Default viewport for all jobs. Free: 390/768/1280. Shotbot Pro: custom 280-3840.

name: batch
